rows.title: 🧵 Three Names to Keep in Your Pocket
rows.cue: Leaving BSÍ — no window required.

rows.title: 🧍 Jóhannes Sveinsson Kjarval
rows.cue: Straight ahead now, sliding to your left as we pass — Kjarvalsstaðir in Klambratún Park.

rows.title: 🏢 Ölgerðin Egill Skallagrímsson
rows.cue: Coming up on your right at 1 o'clock — Egils Brewery.

rows.title: 🏞️ Elliðaárdalur
rows.cue: Look right at 2 o'clock — Elliðaárdalur.

rows.title: ⛰️ Rauðhólar
rows.cue: Look right at 2 o'clock — Rauðhólar.

rows.title: ⛰️ Kristnitökuhraun
rows.cue: Look right at 2 o'clock — Kristnitökuhraun, the Christianity Lava.

rows.title: 🏢 Hellisheiðarvirkjun
rows.cue: Look left at 10 o'clock — the Hellisheiði geothermal plant, up on the shoulder of Skarðsmýrarfjall.

rows.title: 🌊 Ölfusá Intro
rows.cue: Look right at 1–2 o'clock — Ölfusá, ahead in the lowlands.

rows.title: 🌋 Hveragerði
rows.cue: Ahead and just left at 11 o'clock — Hveragerði.

rows.title: 🧭 Ingólfur Arnarson
rows.cue: Look left at 10 o'clock — Ingólfsfjall, the flat-topped mountain named after him.

rows.title: 🏗️ Selfoss
rows.cue: Ahead and right at 1 o'clock, across the Ölfusá — Selfoss.

rows.title: 🌊 Ölfusá
rows.cue: Look right at 1–2 o'clock — Ölfusá.

rows.title: ⚡ Sog River
rows.cue: Out to your left at 10 o'clock — the Sog, a kilometre and a half off. We never cross it.

rows.title: 🎵 Grímsnes & Kerið
rows.cue: Coming up on your right at 1 o'clock — Kerið crater.

rows.title: 💙 Brúará
rows.cue: The bridge just ahead — crossing Brúará.

rows.title: ⛪ Skálholt
rows.cue: Off to your right at 3 o'clock — Skálholt, just under three kilometres down the side road.

rows.title: 🐎 Icelandic Horses
rows.cue: Look at the horses in the field.

rows.title: 🍅 Reykholt & Friðheimar
rows.cue: Passing Friðheimar, Reykholt.

rows.title: ⚡ Tungufljót
rows.cue: The bridge just ahead — crossing the Tungufljót.

rows.title: ⚖️ The Sturlung Age
rows.cue: *The 13th-century chapter most tours skip.*

rows.title: 💧 Hvítá & Gullfoss
rows.cue: At Gullfoss.

rows.title: ⚖️ Haukadalur
rows.cue: Coming up on your right at 2 o'clock — Haukadalur, the valley Geysir sits in.

rows.title: ⛲ Geysir
rows.cue: At the geothermal field — Strokkur and Geysir.

rows.title: 🎧 Music Leg
rows.cue: Leaving Geysir for Þingvellir. Playlist on, mic live between the stops.

rows.title: 🛁 Laugarvatn & Apavatn
rows.cue: Look left at 9 o'clock — Laugarvatn.

rows.title: 🌋 Hekla
rows.cue: Look back over your left shoulder at 7 o'clock — Hekla, just under sixty kilometres out. Clear days only.
notes: pin 17.3 km PAST closest approach — arrow points backwards

rows.title: 🕳️ The Cave People
rows.cue: Ahead and right at 2 o'clock — Laugarvatnshellir, a little over two kilometres off the road.

rows.title: 🚢 The Norse Expansion (793–1066 CE)
rows.cue: Approaching Þingvellir.

rows.title: 🏘️ Landnám
rows.cue: Crossing the Settlement Era.

rows.title: 🌍 Almannagjá
rows.cue: We are walking down inside the crack. The wall on your left is the edge of North America.

rows.title: ⚖️ Lögberg & the Alþingi
rows.cue: At the Law Rock — the wall behind you is the reason this spot was chosen.

rows.title: ⚖️ Kristnitaka
rows.cue: Standing at Lögberg. This is the exact ground where it was decided.

rows.title: ⛪ Þingvallabær & Skáldareitur
rows.cue: The white church and the five-gabled farmhouse on your right, at the bottom of the wall.

rows.title: 💧 Öxarárfoss, Drekkingarhylur & Peningagjá
rows.cue: Follow the Öxará. The waterfall ahead, the still green pool below it, and the coin-filled crack by the bridge.

rows.title: 🐟 Þingvallavatn & Silfra
rows.cue: The lake filling the rift ahead of you, and the clear pools off to the side.

rows.title: 🇮🇸 17 June 1944
rows.cue: Back at the Law Rock. This is where the country stopped belonging to anybody else.

rows.title: 🎧 Music Leg
rows.cue: Leaving Þingvellir — my own playlist from here to BSÍ.

rows.title: 🪶 Gljúfrasteinn
rows.cue: Coming up ahead — the white house by the river Kaldakvísl, just off Route 36.

rows.title: 🎬 Laxnes Horse Farm
rows.cue: Look right on Route 36 — Laxnes, about 400 metres up the side road.

rows.title: 🪶 Mosfellsdalur
rows.cue: All around — Mosfellsdalur.

rows.title: 🎵 Mosfellsbær
rows.cue: All around — Mosfellsbær.

rows.title: ⚖️ Kjalarnesþing
rows.cue: Out to your right at 3 o'clock across the bay — Kjalarnes, under the foot of Esja, five kilometres off.
notes: pin 2.1 km PAST closest approach — arrow points backwards

rows.title: ⛰️ Mount Esja
rows.cue: Look right at 2 o'clock — Esja on the skyline.
notes: pin 2.7 km PAST closest approach — arrow points backwards
